slides.title: Did you know they're different?
slides.ask: Melanotan I (afamelanotide) is an approved drug, Melanotan II is not. Ever seen MT-II marketed as the 'legal equivalent' of the drug? Got a question or a bad experience? Comment or DM.
slides.foot: Educational content, not medical advice. More: pepsafe.info

caption:
Melanotan I and Melanotan II are different substances 🧪 One is an approved drug, the other isn't. Did you know? Has anyone sold you MT-II as 'basically the same as the drug'? Tell us — we're collecting questions for the next post.
